source_mechanic: Turn-based grid tactics where a program's health equals the number of grid cells it occupies.
transformation: A self-contained quilt battlefield uses original procedural colors and polyomino footprints. Player patches translate one square or remove an edge cell from a neighboring rival; the deterministic opponent moves or chips a neighboring player after END TURN. The browser, live grader, and exported verifier share the same cell geometry and replay rules.
original_assets: Procedural CSS cells, seams, and glyph-free patch labels; no source artwork copied.
